answer_1.quote: In our work, we prompt GPT-3.5-Turbo to generate graded gender-biased text.
answer_1.outputs: 1000 English sentences with graded gender bias scores ranging from 0 (least negatively biased) to 1 (most negatively biased)

answer_3.quote: We prompt GPT-3.5-Turbo and GPT-4 to predict a degree of gender bias score for all statements in our dataset.

answer_4.quote: We recruited 20 annotators from within Microsoft Research India who had some basic understanding of gender bias to perform the annotation task.
answer_4.guideline: gender bias as 'the systematic, unequal treatment based on one's gender.'
